name: chengju-iqs
description: 澄矩 · ChengJu (IQS) - 工业智能质量控制工作站 · 鹿溪联合创新实验室
author: 江西省上饶市烟草专卖局（公司）信息中心

scripts.validate:dsl: node scripts/validate_dsl.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/lint_examples.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_card_contracts.ts
scripts.test:flow: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_flow_parser.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_flow_svg.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_flow_bpmn.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_mainline.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_cell_order.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_flow_alignment.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/assert_flow_geometry.ts
scripts.build: npm run validate:dsl && npm run test:fishbone && npm run test:relation && npm run test:pdpc && npm run test:flow && npm run sync-tools && npm run build:mcp-lint && npm run check:mcp-lint-fresh && vite build
scripts.mcp:stdio: test -d mcp-server/node_modules || npm run mcp:install; IQS_BASE_URL=${IQS_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:12000} node mcp-server/index.js
scripts.mcp:sse: test -d mcp-server/node_modules || npm run mcp:install; IQS_BASE_URL=${IQS_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:12000} PORT=${PORT:-12001} node mcp-server/index.js --transport=sse
